name: Cervical Rib Syndrome
definition: Symptoms caused by a cervical rib or elongated C7 transverse process contributing to neurovascular compression at the thoracic outlet.

core: Thoracic outlet provocative maneuvers interpreted cautiously

differentials: Thoracic outlet syndrome without cervical rib

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT identify cervical rib anatomy; vascular imaging or electrodiagnostics are selected according to subtype.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Postural/scapular rehabilitation in stable neurogenic cases
amber: Vascular compromise or persistent severe neurogenic symptoms require specialist thoracic/vascular assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Upper-limb Vata phenotype may be documented while structural compression remains explicit.

patientEducation.summary: Symptoms caused by a cervical rib or elongated C7 transverse process contributing to neurovascular compression at the thoracic outlet.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
